name: LSZ.TruncatedWittVector.coeff_map
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coeff_map (f : R →+* S) (x : TruncatedWittVector p n R) (i : Fin n) :
    (map (p := p) f x).coeff i = f (x.coeff i)

name: LSZ.TruncatedWittVector.map_comp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma map_comp (f : R →+* S) {T : Type u} [CommRing T] (g : S →+* T) :
    (map (p := p) (n := n) g).comp (map (p := p) f) =
      map (p := p) (g.comp f)

name: LSZ.TruncatedWittVector.map_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma map_id : map (p := p) (n := n) (RingHom.id R) =

name: LSZ.TruncatedWittVector.map_wittVector_truncate
statement:
@[simp]
lemma map_wittVector_truncate (f : R →+* S) (x : WittVector p R) :
    map (n := n) f (WittVector.truncate n x) =
      WittVector.truncate n (WittVector.map f x)

name: LSZ.specialFiberPoint_frobenius
statement:
lemma specialFiberPoint_frobenius :
    specialFiberPoint p k ≫ w₂FrobeniusSpec p k =
      fieldFrobeniusSpec p k ≫ specialFiberPoint p k

name: LSZ.w₂Reduction_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma w₂Reduction_apply (x : W₂ p k) : w₂Reduction p k x = x.coeff ⟨0, by omega⟩

name: LSZ.w₂Reduction_eq_zero_iff_exists_mul_p
statement:
lemma w₂Reduction_eq_zero_iff_exists_mul_p [PerfectField k] (x : W₂ p k) :
    w₂Reduction p k x = 0 ↔ ∃ y : W₂ p k, x = y * p

name: LSZ.w₂Reduction_frobenius
statement:
@[simp]
lemma w₂Reduction_frobenius :
    (w₂Reduction p k).comp (w₂Frobenius p k) =
      (frobenius k p).comp (w₂Reduction p k)

name: LSZ.w₂Reduction_mul_p
statement:
lemma w₂Reduction_mul_p (x : W₂ p k) :
    w₂Reduction p k (x * p) = 0

name: LSZ.w₂Reduction_surjective

name: LSZ.w₂Reduction_wittVector_truncate
statement:
@[simp]
lemma w₂Reduction_wittVector_truncate (x : WittVector p k) :
    w₂Reduction p k (WittVector.truncate 2 x) = x.coeff 0

name: LSZ.w₂_mul_p_eq_zero_iff_reduction_eq_zero
statement:
lemma w₂_mul_p_eq_zero_iff_reduction_eq_zero [PerfectField k] (x : W₂ p k) :

name: LSZ.w₂_p_sq

name: LSZ.AffineFrobeniusAtlas.local_frobenius_commutes

name: LSZ.Global.GlobalCartierData.correction_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma correction_apply (D : GlobalCartierData T F)
    (E : SchemeObject.IntegrableHiggs T)
    (U : X.Opens) (v : Γ(T.tangent, U)) (m : Γ(pulledBackCarrier F E, U)) :
    D.correction E U v m = D.pullbackTheta E U (D.zeta U v) m

name: LSZ.Global.GlobalCartierData.correction_commutes
statement:
lemma correction_commutes (D : GlobalCartierData T F)
    (E : SchemeObject.IntegrableHiggs T)
    (U : X.Opens) (v w : Γ(T.tangent, U))
    (m : Γ(pulledBackCarrier F E, U)) :
    D.correction E U v (D.correction E U w m) =
      D.correction E U w (D.correction E U v m)

name: LSZ.Global.GlobalCartierData.correction_natural
statement:
lemma correction_natural (D : GlobalCartierData T F)
    {E G : SchemeObject.IntegrableHiggs T} (f : E ⟶ G)
    (U : X.Opens) (v : Γ(T.tangent, U)) (m : Γ(pulledBackCarrier F E, U)) :
    ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback F).map f.hom).app U
        (D.correction E U v m) =
      D.correction G U v
        (((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback F).map f.hom).app U m)

name: LSZ.Global.GlobalCartierData.correction_restrict
statement:
lemma correction_restrict (D : GlobalCartierData T F)
    (E : SchemeObject.IntegrableHiggs T)
    {U V : X.Opens} (i : U ⟶ V) (v : Γ(T.tangent, V))
    (m : Γ(pulledBackCarrier F E, V)) :
    (pulledBackCarrier F E).presheaf.map i.op (D.correction E V v m) =
      D.correction E U (T.tangent.presheaf.map i.op v)
        ((pulledBackCarrier F E).presheaf.map i.op m)

name: LSZ.Global.GlobalCartierData.correction_smul
statement:
lemma correction_smul (D : GlobalCartierData T F)
    (E : SchemeObject.IntegrableHiggs T)
    (U : X.Opens) (v : Γ(T.tangent, U))
    (a : Γ(X, U)) (m : Γ(pulledBackCarrier F E, U)) :
    D.correction E U v (a • m) = a • D.correction E U v m

name: LSZ.Global.GlobalDividedFrobeniusData.nabla_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma nabla_apply (D : GlobalDividedFrobeniusData T F)
    (E : SchemeObject.IntegrableHiggs T)
    (U : X.Opens) (v : Γ(T.tangent, U)) (m : Γ(pulledBackCarrier F E, U)) :
    D.nabla E U v m =
      D.canonicalNabla E U v m + D.toGlobalCartierData.correction E U v m

name: LSZ.Global.GlobalDividedFrobeniusData.nabla_flat
statement:
lemma nabla_flat (D : GlobalDividedFrobeniusData T F)
    (E : SchemeObject.IntegrableHiggs T)
    (U : X.Opens) (v w : Γ(T.tangent, U))
    (m : Γ(pulledBackCarrier F E, U)) :
    D.nabla E U (T.bracket U v w) m =
      D.nabla E U v (D.nabla E U w m) -
        D.nabla E U w (D.nabla E U v m)

name: LSZ.Global.GlobalDividedFrobeniusData.nabla_leibniz
statement:
lemma nabla_leibniz (D : GlobalDividedFrobeniusData T F)
    (E : SchemeObject.IntegrableHiggs T)
    (U : X.Opens) (v : Γ(T.tangent, U))
    (a : Γ(X, U)) (m : Γ(pulledBackCarrier F E, U)) :
    D.nabla E U v (a • m) =
      a • D.nabla E U v m + T.anchor U v a • m

name: LSZ.Global.GlobalDividedFrobeniusData.nabla_natural
statement:
lemma nabla_natural (D : GlobalDividedFrobeniusData T F)
    {E G : SchemeObject.IntegrableHiggs T} (f : E ⟶ G)
    (U : X.Opens) (v : Γ(T.tangent, U))
    (m : Γ(pulledBackCarrier F E, U)) :
    ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback F).map f.hom).app U
        (D.nabla E U v m) =
      D.nabla G U v
        (((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback F).map f.hom).app U m)

name: LSZ.Global.GlobalDividedFrobeniusData.nabla_restrict
statement:
lemma nabla_restrict (D : GlobalDividedFrobeniusData T F)
    (E : SchemeObject.IntegrableHiggs T)
    {U V : X.Opens} (i : U ⟶ V) (v : Γ(T.tangent, V))
    (m : Γ(pulledBackCarrier F E, V)) :
    (pulledBackCarrier F E).presheaf.map i.op (D.nabla E V v m) =
      D.nabla E U (T.tangent.presheaf.map i.op v)
        ((pulledBackCarrier F E).presheaf.map i.op m)

name: LSZ.TruncatedExp.coe_unit

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.add_tmul
statement:
lemma add_tmul (M N : Modules R) (U : Cᵒᵖ)
    (m m' : M.val.obj U) (n : N.val.obj U) :
    tmul R M N U (m + m') n = tmul R M N U m n + tmul R M N U m' n

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.directHom_comp
statement:

lemma directHom_comp {M N P : Modules R} (f : M ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ P) :

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.map_tensorPure_add_left
statement:
lemma map_tensorPure_add_left {P : PresheafOfModules (ringSheaf R).obj}
    (f : tensorPresheaf R M N ⟶ P) (U : Cᵒᵖ)
    (m m' : M.val.obj U) (n : N.val.obj U) :
    f.app U (tensorPure R M N U (m + m') n) =
      f.app U (tensorPure R M N U m n) +
        f.app U (tensorPure R M N U m' n)

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.map_tensorPure_add_right
statement:
lemma map_tensorPure_add_right {P : PresheafOfModules (ringSheaf R).obj}
    (f : tensorPresheaf R M N ⟶ P) (U : Cᵒᵖ)
    (m : M.val.obj U) (n n' : N.val.obj U) :
    f.app U (tensorPure R M N U m (n + n')) =
      f.app U (tensorPure R M N U m n) +
        f.app U (tensorPure R M N U m n')

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.map_tensorPure_smul_left

lemma map_tensorPure_smul_left {P : PresheafOfModules (ringSheaf R).obj}

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.map_tensorPure_smul_right

statement:

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.tensorHom_comp

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.tensorHom_tmul
statement:
lemma tensorHom_tmul {M M' N N' : Modules R}
    (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') (U : Cᵒᵖ)
    (m : M.val.obj U) (n : N.val.obj U) :

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.tensorPresheafHom_tensorPure
statement:
lemma tensorPresheafHom_tensorPure {M M' N N' : Modules R}

    (m : M.val.obj U) (n : N.val.obj U) :
    (tensorPresheafHom R f g).app U (tensorPure R M N U m n) =
      tensorPure R M' N' U (f.val.app U m) (g.val.app U n)

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.tensorPure_add_left
statement:
lemma tensorPure_add_left (M N : Modules R) (U : Cᵒᵖ)
    (m m' : M.val.obj U) (n : N.val.obj U) :
    tensorPure R M N U (m + m') n =
      tensorPure R M N U m n + tensorPure R M N U m' n

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.tensorPure_add_right
statement:
lemma tensorPure_add_right (M N : Modules R) (U : Cᵒᵖ)
    (m : M.val.obj U) (n n' : N.val.obj U) :
    tensorPure R M N U m (n + n') =
      tensorPure R M N U m n + tensorPure R M N U m n'

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.tensorPure_map
statement:
lemma tensorPure_map (M N : Modules R) {U V : Cᵒᵖ} (f : U ⟶ V)
    (m : M.val.obj U) (n : N.val.obj U) :
    (tensorPresheaf R M N).map f (tensorPure R M N U m n) =
      tensorPure R M N V (M.val.map f m) (N.val.map f n)

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.tensorPure_smul_left

lemma tensorPure_smul_left (M N : Modules R) (U : Cᵒᵖ)
    (a : (ringSheaf R).obj.obj U) (m : M.val.obj U) (n : N.val.obj U) :
    tensorPure R M N U (a • m) n = a • tensorPure R M N U m n

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.tensorPure_smul_right

lemma tensorPure_smul_right (M N : Modules R) (U : Cᵒᵖ)

lemma tensorPure_zero_left (M N : Modules R) (U : Cᵒᵖ)

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.tensorPure_zero_right

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.tmul_add
statement:
lemma tmul_add (M N : Modules R) (U : Cᵒᵖ)
    (m : M.val.obj U) (n n' : N.val.obj U) :
    tmul R M N U m (n + n') = tmul R M N U m n + tmul R M N U m n'

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.tmul_map
statement:
lemma tmul_map (M N : Modules R) {U V : Cᵒᵖ} (f : U ⟶ V)
    (m : M.val.obj U) (n : N.val.obj U) :
    (show (tensorObj R M N).val.obj V from
      (tensorObj R M N).val.map f (tmul R M N U m n)) =
      tmul R M N V (M.val.map f m) (N.val.map f n)

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.tmul_smul

lemma tmul_smul (M N : Modules R) (U : Cᵒᵖ)

    tmul R M N U m (a • n) = a • tmul R M N U m n

lemma tmul_zero (M N : Modules R) (U : Cᵒᵖ) (m : M.val.obj U) :

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.VectorField.add_deriv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma add_deriv (D E : X.VectorField U) (V : X.scheme.Opens) (hV : V ≤ U) :
    (D + E).deriv V hV = D.deriv V hV + E.deriv V hV

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.VectorField.bracket_deriv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma bracket_deriv (D E : X.VectorField U) (V : X.scheme.Opens) (hV : V ≤ U) :
    ⁅D, E⁆.deriv V hV = ⁅D.deriv V hV, E.deriv V hV⁆

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.VectorField.neg_deriv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma neg_deriv (D : X.VectorField U) (V : X.scheme.Opens) (hV : V ≤ U) :
    (-D).deriv V hV = -D.deriv V hV

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.VectorField.restrict_deriv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_deriv (D : X.VectorField U) (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (W : X.scheme.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ V) :
    (D.restrict hVU).deriv W hWV = D.deriv W (hWV.trans hVU)

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.VectorField.smul_deriv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma smul_deriv (a : Γ(X.scheme, U)) (D : X.VectorField U)
    (V : X.scheme.Opens) (hV : V ≤ U) :
    (a • D).deriv V hV =
      (X.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op a) • D.deriv V hV

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.VectorField.zero_deriv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma zero_deriv (V : X.scheme.Opens) (hV : V ≤ U) :

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.bundled_smul_eq_smul
statement:
lemma bundled_smul_eq_smul (M : X.scheme.Modules) (U : X.scheme.Opens)
    (a : Γ(X.scheme, U)) (m : Γ(M, U)) :

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.higgsTensorMap_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma higgsTensorMap_tmul {M N : X.scheme.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (U : X.scheme.Opens) (D : X.VectorField U) (m : Γ(M, U)) :
    (higgsTensorMap X f).app U (higgsTmul X M U D m) =

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.higgsTmul_add_left
statement:
lemma higgsTmul_add_left (M : X.scheme.Modules) (U : X.scheme.Opens)
    (D E : X.VectorField U) (m : Γ(M, U)) :

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.higgsTmul_add_right
statement:
lemma higgsTmul_add_right (M : X.scheme.Modules) (U : X.scheme.Opens)

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.higgsTmul_restrict
statement:

lemma higgsTmul_restrict (M : X.scheme.Modules) {U V : X.scheme.Opens}

    (higgsTensor X M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op
        (higgsTmul X M U D m) =
      higgsTmul X M V (D.restrict hVU)
        (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op m)

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.higgsTmul_smul_right

lemma higgsTmul_smul_right (M : X.scheme.Modules) (U : X.scheme.Opens)

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.tangentSection_add

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.vectorFieldAbPresheaf_map_smul
statement:
lemma vectorFieldAbPresheaf_map_smul {U V : X.scheme.Opensᵒᵖ}

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.vectorFieldAsPresheafSection_map

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.vectorFieldAsPresheafSection_smul
statement:

    vectorFieldAsPresheafSection X U ((show Γ(X.scheme, U) from a) • D) =

statement:

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.extensionUnit_naturality

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.mappedSection_smul

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.restrictionToExtensionApp_unit
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrictionToExtensionApp_unit
    (N : PresheafOfModules.{u} (B ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    (g : M ⟶ (PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (ringMap alpha)).obj N)
    (U : Cᵒᵖ) (m : M.obj U) :

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.extensionTensorPresheafIso_naturality
statement:
lemma extensionTensorPresheafIso_naturality
    {M M' N N' :
      PresheafOfModules.{u} (A ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)}
    (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') :
    (extensionPresheafFunctor alpha).map (f ⊗ₘ g) ≫
        (extensionTensorPresheafIso alpha M' N').hom =
      (extensionTensorPresheafIso alpha M N).hom ≫
        ((extensionPresheafFunctor alpha).map f ⊗ₘ
          (extensionPresheafFunctor alpha).map g)

name: LSZ.CommRingSheaf.extensionTensorSectionIso_hom_unit_tmul
statement:

      extensionUnit alpha M U m ⊗ₜ[B.obj U]
        extensionUnit alpha N U n

        (hom (R := R) (S := S) (M := N)) =
      (hom (R := R) (S := S) (M := M)).comp
        (LinearMap.baseChange S f.dualMap)

name: LSZ.FiniteProjectiveDualBaseChange.hom_tmul_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma hom_tmul_apply (s t : S) (phi : Module.Dual R M) (m : M) :
    hom (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (s ⊗ₜ[R] phi) (t ⊗ₜ[R] m) =
      s * (algebraMap R S (phi m) * t)

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.ConnectionHom.comp_hom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ConnectionHom.comp_hom {M N P : X.IntegrableConnection}
    (f : M ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ P) :
    (f ≫ g).hom = f.hom ≫ g.hom

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.ConnectionHom.ext
LSZ.SmoothScheme.ConnectionHom.horizontal
statement:
lemma horizontal (f : X.ConnectionHom M N) (U : X.scheme.Opens)
    (D : X.VectorField U) (m : Γ(M.carrier, U)) :
    f.hom.app U (M.nabla U D m) = N.nabla U D (f.hom.app U m)

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.ConnectionHom.id_hom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ConnectionHom.id_hom (M : X.IntegrableConnection) :
    (𝟙 M : M ⟶ M).hom = 𝟙 M.carrier

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.HiggsHom.commutes
statement:
lemma commutes (f : X.HiggsHom E F) (U : X.scheme.Opens)
    (D : X.VectorField U) (m : Γ(E.carrier, U)) :
    f.hom.app U (E.theta U D m) = F.theta U D (f.hom.app U m)

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.HiggsHom.comp_hom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma HiggsHom.comp_hom {E F G : X.IntegrableHiggs}
    (f : E ⟶ F) (g : F ⟶ G) :

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.HiggsHom.ext
statement:

lemma HiggsHom.ext {E F : X.IntegrableHiggs} (f g : X.HiggsHom E F)

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.HiggsHom.id_hom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma HiggsHom.id_hom (E : X.IntegrableHiggs) :
    (𝟙 E : E ⟶ E).hom = 𝟙 E.carrier

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.IntegrableConnection.flat
statement:
lemma flat (C : X.IntegrableConnection) (U : X.scheme.Opens)
    (D E : X.VectorField U) (m : Γ(C.carrier, U)) :
    C.nabla U ⁅D, E⁆ m =
      C.nabla U D (C.nabla U E m) - C.nabla U E (C.nabla U D m)

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.IntegrableConnection.leibniz
statement:
lemma leibniz (C : X.IntegrableConnection) (U : X.scheme.Opens)
    (D : X.VectorField U) (a : Γ(X.scheme, U))
    (m : Γ(C.carrier, U)) :
    C.nabla U D (a • m) = a • C.nabla U D m + D.act a • m

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.IntegrableConnection.nabla_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma nabla_apply (C : X.IntegrableConnection) (U : X.scheme.Opens)
    (D : X.VectorField U) (m : Γ(C.carrier, U)) :
    C.nabla U D m =
      C.nablaHom.hom.app (.op U) (connectionTmul X C.carrier U D m)

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.IntegrableConnection.nabla_restrict
statement:
lemma nabla_restrict (C : X.IntegrableConnection)
    {U V : X.scheme.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (D : X.VectorField U) (m : Γ(C.carrier, U)) :
    C.carrier.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (C.nabla U D m) =
      C.nabla V (D.restrict hVU)
        (C.carrier.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op m)

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.IntegrableHiggs.integrable
statement:
lemma integrable (E : X.IntegrableHiggs) (U : X.scheme.Opens)

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.IntegrableHiggs.theta_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma theta_apply (E : X.IntegrableHiggs) (U : X.scheme.Opens)

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.IntegrableHiggs.theta_restrict
statement:
lemma theta_restrict (E : X.IntegrableHiggs)
    {U V : X.scheme.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (D : X.VectorField U) (m : Γ(E.carrier, U)) :
    E.carrier.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (E.theta U D m) =
      E.theta V (D.restrict hVU)

name: Derivation.iterate_apply_mul
statement:
theorem iterate_apply_mul (D : Derivation R A A) (n : ℕ) (a b : A) :
    D^[n] (a * b) =
      ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal n, choose n ij.1 • (D^[ij.1] a * D^[ij.2] b)

name: Derivation.iterate_apply_mul'
statement:
theorem iterate_apply_mul' (D : Derivation R A A) (n : ℕ) (a b : A) :
    D^[n] (a * b) =
      ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), choose n i • (D^[i] a * D^[n - i] b)

name: Derivation.iterate_prime_leibniz
statement:
theorem iterate_prime_leibniz (D : Derivation R A A) (p : ℕ)
    [CharP A p] (hp : p.Prime) (a b : A) :
    D^[p] (a * b) = a * D^[p] b + b * D^[p] a

name: Derivation.restrictedPowerField_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrictedPowerField_apply (D : Derivation K B B) (p : ℕ)

name: Derivation.restrictedPower_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrictedPower_apply (D : Derivation R A A) (p : ℕ)

name: LSZ.map_iterate
statement:
lemma map_iterate {A : Type u} {B : Type v} (r : A → B) (f : A → A) (g : B → B)

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.IntegrableConnection.pCurvatureAdditive_add
statement:
lemma pCurvatureAdditive_add (U : X.scheme.Opens) (D : X.VectorField U)

    C.pCurvatureAdditive U D (m + n) =

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.IntegrableConnection.pCurvatureAdditive_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma pCurvatureAdditive_apply (U : X.scheme.Opens) (D : X.VectorField U)
    (m : Γ(C.carrier, U)) :
    C.pCurvatureAdditive U D m =
      (C.nabla U D)^[ringChar k] m - C.nabla U D.pPower m

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.IntegrableConnection.pCurvatureAdditive_smul
statement:
lemma pCurvatureAdditive_smul (U : X.scheme.Opens) (D : X.VectorField U)

    C.pCurvatureAdditive U D (a • m) =

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.IntegrableConnection.pCurvatureEndomorphismOn_app
statement:
@[simp]
lemma pCurvatureEndomorphismOn_app (U : X.scheme.Opens)
    (D : X.VectorField U) (V : (Over U)ᵒᵖ)
    (m : (C.carrier.over U).val.obj V) :
    (C.pCurvatureEndomorphismOn U D).val.app V m =

        (D.restrict (leOfHom V.unop.hom)) m

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.IntegrableConnection.pCurvatureEndomorphismOn_smul
statement:
lemma pCurvatureEndomorphismOn_smul (U : X.scheme.Opens)
    (D : X.VectorField U) (V : (Over U)ᵒᵖ)
    (a : (X.scheme.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj.obj V)
    (m : (C.carrier.over U).val.obj V) :
    (C.pCurvatureEndomorphismOn U D).val.app V (a • m) =

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.IntegrableConnection.pCurvatureEndomorphism_app
statement:
@[simp]
lemma pCurvatureEndomorphism_app (D : X.VectorField ⊤)
    (U : X.scheme.Opens) (m : Γ(C.carrier, U)) :

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.IntegrableConnection.pCurvature_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma pCurvature_apply (U : X.scheme.Opens) (D : X.VectorField U)

name: LSZ.SmoothScheme.IntegrableConnection.pCurvature_restrict
statement:
lemma pCurvature_restrict {U V : X.scheme.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)

    C.carrier.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (C.pCurvature U D m) =

name: LSZ.connection_iterate_smul
statement:
theorem connection_iterate_smul (D : Derivation R A A)
    (N : Module.End ℤ M)
    (hN : ∀ (a : A) (m : M), N (a • m) = a • N m + D a • m)
    (n : ℕ) (a : A) (m : M) :
    N^[n] (a • m) =
      ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal n,
        choose n ij.1 • ((D^[ij.1] a) • (N^[ij.2] m))

name: LSZ.connection_iterate_smul'
statement:
theorem connection_iterate_smul' (D : Derivation R A A)
    (N : Module.End ℤ M)
    (hN : ∀ (a : A) (m : M), N (a • m) = a • N m + D a • m)
    (n : ℕ) (a : A) (m : M) :
    N^[n] (a • m) =
      ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1),
        choose n i • ((D^[i] a) • (N^[n - i] m))

name: LSZ.connection_prime_smul
statement:
theorem connection_prime_smul (D : Derivation R A A)
    (N : Module.End ℤ M)
    (hN : ∀ (a : A) (m : M), N (a • m) = a • N m + D a • m)
    (p : ℕ) [CharP A p] (hp : p.Prime) (a : A) (m : M) :
    N^[p] (a • m) = a • N^[p] m + D^[p] a • m

name: LSZ.connection_prime_smul_field
statement:
theorem connection_prime_smul_field {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra K A]
    (D : Derivation K A A) (N : Module.End ℤ M)
    (hN : ∀ (a : A) (m : M), N (a • m) = a • N m + D a • m)
    (p : ℕ) [CharP K p] (hp : p.Prime) (a : A) (m : M) :
    N^[p] (a • m) = a • N^[p] m + D^[p] a • m

name: LSZ.adPolynomial_pred_eq_derivative_pow
statement:
theorem adPolynomial_pred_eq_derivative_pow (p : ℕ) [CharP K p]
    (hp : p.Prime) (x y : B) :
    adPolynomial x y (p - 1) =
      Polynomial.derivative
        ((Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C x + Polynomial.C y) ^ p)

name: LSZ.ad_pow_pred_eq_sum
statement:
theorem ad_pow_pred_eq_sum (p : ℕ) [CharP K p] (hp : p.Prime)
    (z w : B) :
    (LieAlgebra.ad K B z ^ (p - 1)) w =
      ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal (p - 1), z ^ ij.1 * w * z ^ ij.2

name: LSZ.add_pow_eq_add_pow_add_jacobson
statement:
theorem add_pow_eq_add_pow_add_jacobson (p : ℕ) [CharP K p]
    (hp : p.Prime) (x y : B) :
    (x + y) ^ p = x ^ p + y ^ p + jacobsonCorrection K p x y

name: LSZ.coeff_adPolynomial
statement:
theorem coeff_adPolynomial (x y : B) (n i : ℕ) :
    (adPolynomial x y n).coeff i = jacobsonCoeff x y n i

name: LSZ.coeff_generic_pow_eq_jacobson
statement:
theorem coeff_generic_pow_eq_jacobson (p : ℕ) [CharP K p]
    (hp : p.Prime) (x y : B) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < p - 1) :
    ((Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C x + Polynomial.C y) ^ p).coeff (j + 1) =
      (((j + 1 : ℕ) : K)⁻¹) • jacobsonCoeff x y (p - 1) j

name: LSZ.coeff_zero_hochschild_extension_term
statement:
theorem coeff_zero_hochschild_extension_term (D : Derivation K A A)
    (a : A) (r n j : ℕ) :
    (hochschildCoeff (polynomialExtension D) (Polynomial.C a) r j *
        (polynomialExtension D)^[j] (Polynomial.X ^ n)).coeff 0 =
      if j = n then hochschildCoeff D a r n * (n.factorial : A) else 0

name: LSZ.connection_smul_pow
statement:
theorem connection_smul_pow (a : Γ(X.scheme, U))
    (D : X.VectorField U) :
    (C.nabla U (a • D)) ^ ringChar k =
      a ^ ringChar k • (C.nabla U D) ^ ringChar k +
        ((a • D.act : Γ(X.scheme, U) → Γ(X.scheme, U))^[ringChar k - 1] a) •
          C.nabla U D

name: LSZ.derivationToEndLieHom_injective
statement:
theorem derivationToEndLieHom_injective :
    Function.Injective (derivationToEndLieHom (K := K) (A := A))

name: LSZ.derivation_hochschildCoeff_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivation_hochschildCoeff_zero (D : Derivation K A A)
    (a : A) (n : ℕ) : D (hochschildCoeff D a n 0) = 0

name: LSZ.derivative_pow_noncomm
statement:
theorem derivative_pow_noncomm (q : B[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    Polynomial.derivative (q ^ n) =
      ∑ i ∈ range n,
        q ^ i * Polynomial.derivative q * q ^ (n - 1 - i)

name: LSZ.fieldAlgebraFrobenius_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fieldAlgebraFrobenius_apply (k A : Type*) [Field k] [CommRing A]
    [Algebra k A] [NeZero (ringChar k)] (a : A) :
    fieldAlgebraFrobenius k A a = a ^ ringChar k

name: LSZ.hochschildCoeff_diagonal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hochschildCoeff_diagonal (D : Derivation K A A) (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
    hochschildCoeff D a n n = a ^ n

name: LSZ.hochschildCoeff_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hochschildCoeff_eq_zero_of_lt (D : Derivation K A A) (a : A)
    {n j : ℕ} (h : n < j) : hochschildCoeff D a n j = 0

name: LSZ.hochschildCoeff_map
statement:
theorem hochschildCoeff_map (f : A →ₐ[K] B)
    (D : Derivation K A A) (E : Derivation K B B)
    (hDE : ∀ x, f (D x) = E (f x)) (a : A) (n j : ℕ) :
    f (hochschildCoeff D a n j) = hochschildCoeff E (f a) n j

name: LSZ.hochschildCoeff_middle_eq_zero
statement:
theorem hochschildCoeff_middle_eq_zero (p : ℕ) [CharP K p]
    [hp : Fact p.Prime] (D : Derivation K A A) (a : A) (n : ℕ)
    (hn2 : 2 ≤ n) (hnp : n < p) : hochschildCoeff D a p n = 0

name: LSZ.hochschildCoeff_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hochschildCoeff_one (D : Derivation K A A) (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
    hochschildCoeff D a (n + 1) 1 = (a • D : A → A)^[n] a

name: LSZ.hochschildCoeff_polynomialExtension
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hochschildCoeff_polynomialExtension (D : Derivation K A A)
    (a : A) (n j : ℕ) :
    hochschildCoeff (polynomialExtension D) (Polynomial.C a) n j =
      Polynomial.C (hochschildCoeff D a n j)

name: LSZ.hochschildCoeff_sum_succ
statement:
theorem hochschildCoeff_sum_succ {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    [Module A M] (D : Derivation K A A) (a : A) (F : ℕ → M) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ range (n + 2), hochschildCoeff D a (n + 1) j • F j =
      ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1),
        ((a * D (hochschildCoeff D a n j)) • F j +
          (a * hochschildCoeff D a n j) • F (j + 1))

name: LSZ.hochschildCoeff_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hochschildCoeff_zero (D : Derivation K A A) (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
    hochschildCoeff D a n 0 = if n = 0 then 1 else 0

name: LSZ.jacobsonCoeff_map
statement:
theorem jacobsonCoeff_map (f : L →ₗ⁅K⁆ M) (x y : L) (n i : ℕ) :
    f (jacobsonCoeff x y n i) = jacobsonCoeff (f x) (f y) n i

name: LSZ.jacobsonCoeff_map_linear
statement:
theorem jacobsonCoeff_map_linear (f : L →ₗ[K] M)

name: LSZ.jacobsonCorrection_map
statement:
theorem jacobsonCorrection_map (f : L →ₗ⁅K⁆ M)
    (p : ℕ) (x y : L) :

name: LSZ.jacobsonCorrection_map_linear
statement:
theorem jacobsonCorrection_map_linear (f : L →ₗ[K] M)
    (hbracket : ∀ x y, f ⁅x, y⁆ = ⁅f x, f y⁆)
    (p : ℕ) (x y : L) :
    f (jacobsonCorrection K p x y) =
      jacobsonCorrection K p (f x) (f y)

name: LSZ.nablaBaseEnd_add_pow
statement:
theorem nablaBaseEnd_add_pow (D E : X.VectorField U) :
    (nablaBaseEnd C (D + E)) ^ ringChar k =
      (nablaBaseEnd C D) ^ ringChar k +
        (nablaBaseEnd C E) ^ ringChar k +
          nablaBaseLinearMap C
            (jacobsonCorrection k (ringChar k) D E)

name: LSZ.nablaBaseEnd_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nablaBaseEnd_apply (D : X.VectorField U) (m : Γ(C.carrier, U)) :

name: LSZ.nablaBaseEnd_pow_apply

theorem nablaBaseEnd_pow_apply (D : X.VectorField U) (n : ℕ)

name: LSZ.nablaBaseLinearMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nablaBaseLinearMap_apply (D : X.VectorField U)

name: LSZ.nablaBaseLinearMap_bracket
statement:
theorem nablaBaseLinearMap_bracket (D E : X.VectorField U) :

theorem pCurvatureAdditive_add_vectorField (D E : X.VectorField U) :

theorem pCurvatureFrobeniusSemilinear_apply (U : X.scheme.Opens)

name: LSZ.pCurvature_add_vectorField
statement:
theorem pCurvature_add_vectorField (D E : X.VectorField U) :

name: LSZ.pCurvature_smul_vectorField

theorem pCurvature_smul_vectorField (a : Γ(X.scheme, U))

name: LSZ.polynomialExtension_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem polynomialExtension_C (D : Derivation K A A) (a : A) :

name: LSZ.polynomialExtension_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem polynomialExtension_X (D : Derivation K A A) :

name: LSZ.polynomialExtension_X_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem polynomialExtension_X_pow (D : Derivation K A A) (n : ℕ) :

name: LSZ.polynomialExtension_iterate_X_pow

theorem polynomialExtension_iterate_X_pow (D : Derivation K A A)

name: LSZ.restrictedPowerField_add
statement:
theorem restrictedPowerField_add (p : ℕ) [CharP K p] [hp : Fact p.Prime]
    (D E : Derivation K A A) :
    Derivation.restrictedPowerField (D + E) p =
      Derivation.restrictedPowerField D p +
        Derivation.restrictedPowerField E p +
          jacobsonCorrection K p D E

name: LSZ.restrictedPowerField_smul
statement:
theorem restrictedPowerField_smul (p : ℕ) [CharP K p]
    [Fact p.Prime] (D : Derivation K A A) (a : A) :
    Derivation.restrictedPowerField (a • D) p =
      a ^ p • Derivation.restrictedPowerField D p +
        ((a • D : A → A)^[p - 1] a) • D

name: LSZ.restrictedPowerField_toEnd
statement:
theorem restrictedPowerField_toEnd (p : ℕ) [CharP K p] [Fact p.Prime]
    (D : Derivation K A A) :
    derivationToEndLieHom (Derivation.restrictedPowerField D p) =
      (derivationToEndLieHom D) ^ p

name: LSZ.signed_choose_pred_cast
statement:
theorem signed_choose_pred_cast {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (p : ℕ) [CharP K p] (hp : p.Prime) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < p) :
    ((-1 : K) ^ j) * (Nat.choose (p - 1) j : K) = 1

name: LSZ.smul_derivation_iterate_eq_sum
statement:
theorem smul_derivation_iterate_eq_sum (D : Derivation K A A)
    (a x : A) (n : ℕ) :
    (a • D : A → A)^[n] x =
      ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1),
        hochschildCoeff D a n j * D^[j] x

name: LSZ.smul_derivation_iterate_prime
statement:
theorem smul_derivation_iterate_prime (p : ℕ) [CharP K p]
    [Fact p.Prime] (D : Derivation K A A) (a x : A) :
    (a • D : A → A)^[p] x =
      a ^ p * D^[p] x + ((a • D : A → A)^[p - 1] a) * D x

name: LSZ.smul_operator_mul_smul_pow
statement:
theorem smul_operator_mul_smul_pow (D : Derivation K A A)
    (N : Module.End ℤ M)
    (hN : ∀ (b : A) (m : M), N (b • m) = b • N m + D b • m)
    (a c : A) (j : ℕ) :
    (a • N) * (c • N ^ j) =
      (a * D c) • N ^ j + (a * c) • N ^ (j + 1)

name: LSZ.smul_operator_pow_eq_sum
statement:
theorem smul_operator_pow_eq_sum (D : Derivation K A A)
    (N : Module.End ℤ M)
    (hN : ∀ (b : A) (m : M), N (b • m) = b • N m + D b • m)
    (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
    (a • N) ^ n =
      ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), hochschildCoeff D a n j • N ^ j

name: LSZ.smul_operator_pow_prime
statement:
theorem smul_operator_pow_prime (p : ℕ) [CharP K p]
    [hp : Fact p.Prime] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
    (D : Derivation K A A) (N : Module.End ℤ M)
    (hN : ∀ (b : A) (m : M), N (b • m) = b • N m + D b • m)
    (a : A) :
    (a • N) ^ p =
      a ^ p • N ^ p + ((a • D : A → A)^[p - 1] a) • N

name: LSZ.sum_range_shift_of_boundary_zero
statement:

    (f : ℕ → M) (n : ℕ) (hzero : f 0 = 0) (hlast : f (n + 1) = 0) :
    ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), f (j + 1) = ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), f j

name: LSZ.vectorField_pPower_smul

statement:
theorem vectorField_restrict_smul_act_iterate (D : X.VectorField U)

    X.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op
        ((a • D.act : Γ(X.scheme, U) → Γ(X.scheme, U))^[n] b) =
      ((X.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op a • D.deriv V hV :
